text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —Oh my, so they're making staff for the next Open Campus volunteer-based.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "New proposals also welcome"... If they're trying to revamp it, I wonder if the feedback hasn't been very positive.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Well... it's certainly not an easy world. If they can't feel hope for their future, they probably wouldn't choose to enroll in Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Even so... I totally get that feeling. It's scary not knowing if you can make it in the races...

text_block_list.name: Player Gesocorone
text_block_list.text: She is my star of hope—Nice Nature. With this deck, I want to put up a fight worthy of her!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (But... is it possible that precisely because I'm like this, there's something only I can do...?)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (...For junior students like me, who end up thinking "someone like me could never"...)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I don't know if I can pull it off, but... maybe I'll try coming up with a plan. A proposal...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: That sounds great! Why don't you brainstorm a bit? Oh, do you need data from past Open Campuses? Feel free to use it if you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (Figures. Anything I could think of has probably already been done at past Open Campuses...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sitting before an untouched lunch, Nice Nature was lost in deep thought with a serious expression.
choice_data_list: What's wrong? Something on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer... from before. Well, the truth is—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...And so, completely out of character, I thought maybe I could do something... ahaha. Things never go that smoothly, right?
choice_data_list: Then... how about using TCG as a reference again?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh, card shops host smaller tournaments too, I see.
choice_data_list: Ah!? Isn't that person playing over there...!

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: Nnngh... Even if I use a skill card, my points won't reach...

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: ...I-I'm sorry, I concede. Thank you very much for the game.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yaho, Chrono. Never thought I'd run into you here. Were you playing in the tournament?

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: Oh, Nature-san. Were you watching...? H-How embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Why would it be embarrassing? Though entering a tournament did come as a surprise.

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: Ah, um... I entered because I wanted the promo card. You receive a promo card just for participating...

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: I-It's a promo card featuring all the Triple Tiara horse girls throughout history... From a racing history standpoint, I felt it would be an invaluable piece...!

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: Ah, also... everyone has their own distinct deck themes and playstyles. S-So I came to observe them...
choice_data_list: Distinct themes... like a Nice Nature deck?

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: T-That is true as well... but what I pay attention to are decks that recreate the bonds between horse girls...

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: Ah... that table over there is doing just that. They've laid out the staple cards for relationship-themed decks.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Bamboo-san versus Helios-san. Trainer, which deck catches your eye?
choice_data_list: Bamboo Memory, brimming with burning fighting spirit.
Daitaku Helios, full of tricky unpredictable moves.

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: Bamboo-san is often built into decks with her classmates. T-There are decks that include her entire generation, but—

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: The mainstream variant is the Fierce Rival deck paired with Oguri-san. By triggering their unique skills simultaneously to stack buffs, it aims for a massive one-turn kill...!

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: W-What's interesting is that the Martial Arts Classmate deck, which relies on the tenacity of Bamboo-san and Yaeno-san, acts as the ultimate counter to that Fierce Rival deck...!

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: Growing stronger because there's someone you refuse to lose to. Years of mental discipline cultivated through martial arts showing its true worth.

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: Both decks allow you to feel the intense drama of Bamboo-san and her peers—they're so passionate...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I see. Decks built around horse girls from the same generation...

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: When it comes to Helios-san, it has to be the Gyaru deck. The tricky playstyle is so fascinating...!

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: T-The Besties deck with her classmate Palmer-san uses skill cards to create an "Ultra Hype Zone," pulling the opponent into its effects as well...!

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: Aside from gyarus, decks paired with Ruby-san, who is also her peer, are quite popular...

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: Their performance directly influences one another. I-If they sync up, it's formidable, but a single misplay can prove fatal, making it quite challenging...

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: Feelings toward one's peers influencing how they run... It mirrors real racing so closely...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I see. Decks built around horse girls from the same generation...

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: Yes, just like in historical fact, specific effects often trigger between horse girls of the same generation...

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: L-Look at me... rambling on even though I'm no expert on TCGs... P-Please forgive me!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Not at all, looking at it through racing history was actually super helpful!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —You can become stronger because of the peers beside you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: The hope we should show them at the Open Campus... I think I see it now.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Why don't we show them the kind of strength you could never reach all on your own!
